feeds.title: Hungry Lankan
feeds.description: Hungry Lankan's food blog is Where I share recipes and other food experiments. I'm Roshani Wickramasinghe. And this is my virtual comfort place where I share the best food I make every day. My long-term goal in making this blog is to have a good collection of the best Sri Lankan recipes that anybody can actually rely on. I hope one day I'll get there.

feeds.title: Savory Spin Blog
feeds.description: Hiya, I'm Shashi, the blogger behind Savory Spin. Here you can browse a collection of super easy, economical, mostly fusion recipes that can be made with ingredients from your local grocery store. Find hundreds of deliciously spiced, fusion recipes you can easily make at home. From breakfast to lunch to dinner to your next holiday celebration find the perfect dish to satisfy even the most demanding craving, just by adding some spice!

feeds.title: Food Corner
feeds.description: I am Amila Gamage. Welcome to Food Corner, A Singapore-based food blog with Sri Lankan Recipes & other recipes tried & tasted by me & family members. Find Sri Lankan food recipes with photos. Visit & find Truly Sri Lankan Recipes from a Sri Lankan kitchen.

feeds.title: Pulse
feeds.description: Pulse kicked off as a lifestyle website for the Sri Lankan audience, geared towards creating localized and fresh content. Pulse generates content in the form of articles and videos, including event coverage, local recipes, unbiased food reviews, travel and hotel visits, interviews, and informative text-based videos centered around current events.

feeds.title: Yamu
feeds.description: YAMU (9 plus years) is your digital guide to discovering food and beverage establishments in Colombo and promoting the local lifestyle. People visit the YAMU platform to read about our discoveries within the city, especially when deciding on dining. Simply put, YAMU is your friend in the city.

feeds.title: Top Sri Lankan Recipe
feeds.description: My Name is Rocy. I am a young loving wife and mother of two beautiful kids. I am crazy on foods and always give a try on new dishes. This is my own site and I'm here to share the recipe of top Sri Lankan foods with you. I'm pretty sure that you will like my delicious dishes.

feeds.title: Peckish Me
feeds.description: Hi I am Jayani C. Senanayake. Sri Lankan food is as exotic and mysterious as the island itself and while my concentration isn't on the traditional food in itself, I am fascinated by our quirky eating and cooking habits and the unusual culinary methods. Peckish Me offers authentic Sri Lankan Food recipes for you to try healthy food, delicious healthy snacks and yummy cake recipes to whip up in a hurry.

feeds.title: My Lankan Food Journal Blog
feeds.description: I am Nuzrath Shazeen face of My Lankan Food Journal, I am a chef, a blogger, and a food stylist from the tropical paradise of Sri Lanka. My main aim through my blog is to gift you with my culinary knowledge. A chef's greatest reward lies in the pleasant surprise the guests have when they taste the dishes. I want to ensure your guests and families experience it

feeds.title: Island Smile
feeds.description: A food blog documenting the simple Srilankan life through family, food, and lessons learned along the way. With recipes that are easy, and healthy for families to make for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

feeds.title: Sri Lanka Travel Blog » Food & Drink
feeds.description: Founded in 2000, Red Dot has quietly built a reputation for possessing an intimate, in-depth knowledge of Sri Lanka. Reach out to our blogs to know more about it. Learn various recipes from Sri Lanka, about good places to visit in Sri Lanka, and many more.
